option_relations.rationale: The option describes focal epilepsy with occipital and temporal involvement, which is a type of epilepsy, but it does not specifically mention abdominal epilepsy or connect it directly to the post-COVID-19 context as precisely as the leaf.
Abdominal epilepsy is a broader category that encompasses 'Post-COVID-19 abdominal epilepsy'. The leaf specifies the etiology (post-COVID-19), making it a subtype of general abdominal epilepsy.

Focal-onset epilepsy with abdominal aura is a broader category that includes 'Post-COVID-19 abdominal epilepsy'. The leaf specifies the etiology (post-COVID-19), making it a subtype of this more general description.

The option 'Abdominal epilepsy as sequela of COVID-19' is clinically equivalent to 'Post-COVID-19 abdominal epilepsy'. 'Sequela of' implies 'post-' and both describe the same condition with the same etiology.
